owner: nsc-public-polish clone (separate Git history, macOS origin)
scope: Portable copy of the one commit in this clone that is absent from the canonical repository, as a git-format patch, so the clone can be retired without losing the commit. This is the publication-side cleanup commit; it touches only the three files the public repository carries, because that clone has no lab/ tree.

commit.subject: Clarify research ownership and separate instructions from publication evidence
commit.author: Kodareken Douglas <douglas@swedishsoftwareengineers.com>

coverage_check.rule: A file counts as unique when its path exists neither in the canonical checkout nor in lab/archive/pre-closure-2026-09-08, after discarding macOS metadata (names beginning ._ and .DS_Store) and version-control internals.

patch_state.detail: A three-way check against the 2026-10-05 head applies all three files with conflicts, because HEAD has moved well past this commit. The patch is kept as a portable record of the commit, not as something to apply unreviewed.

why_this_clone_was_kept_until_now: docs/README.md describes it as a separate Git history rather than a worktree, with no lab/ tree and matched docs. That description was checked here rather than assumed.
nonclaim: Preservation of a commit for provenance. It makes no scientific claim and does not assert that the public index text should be adopted.
